title: Getting invalid object name 'tags/warning' when attempting to release
body:
**Describe the bug**

When attempting to release via Azure DevOps Pipeline I get the following during the changelog generation which breaks the release in the end:
```
• generating changelog     
      • running git               args=[-c log.showSignature=false describe --tags --abbrev=0 tags/v0.3.18^]
      • git result                output=warning: refname 'tags/v0.3.18' is ambiguous.
v0.3.17

      • running git               args=[-c log.showSignature=false log --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit --no-decorate --no-color tags/warning: refname tags/v0.3.18 is ambiguous...tags/v0.3.18]
      • git result                output=fatal: invalid object name 'tags/warning'.

   ⨯ release failed after 1.59s error=fatal: invalid object name 'tags/warning'.
```
When disabling changelog generation everything is working as expected.

**To Reproduce**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
I'm not able to reproduce this issue because it is working locally as expected.

`.goreleaser.yaml`:
```yaml
dist: ./artifacts/dist
before:
  hooks:
    - go mod download
    - go generate ./...
builds:
- main: ./cmd/enpxio/enpxio.go
  env:
  - CGO_ENABLED=0
  goos:
    - linux
    - windows
    - darwin
  ldflags:
    - -s -w -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.Version={{.Version}} -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.Commit={{.Commit}} -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.BuiltDate={{.Date}}
archives:
- replacements:
    darwin: Darwin
    linux: Linux
    windows: Windows
    386: i386
    amd64: x86_64
  format_overrides:
  - goos: windows
    format: zip
  name_template: "{{ .ProjectName }}_{{ .Os }}_{{ .Arch }}"
checksum:
  name_template: 'checksums.txt'
release:
  disable: true
changelog:
  skip: false
  sort: asc
  filters:
    exclude:
    - '^docs:'
    - '^test:'
    - '^chore:'
    - '^style:'
    - '^refactor:'
```

**Expected behavior**

The release should create a changelog without errors.

**Environment:**

- OS: `linux`
- OS version: `Linux fv-az695 5.3.0-1034-azure #35~18.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Mon Jul 13 12:54:45 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`
- GoReleaser Version: `0.141.0`
- CI/CD: `Azure DevOps`

```yaml
project_name: enpxio
release:
  github:
    owner: _git
    name: enpxio
  disable: true
  name_template: '{{.Tag}}'
milestones:
- repo:
    owner: _git
    name: enpxio
  name_template: '{{ .Tag }}'
scoop:
  name: enpxio
  commit_author:
    name: goreleaserbot
    email: goreleaser@carlosbecker.com
  commit_msg_template: Scoop update for {{ .ProjectName }} version {{ .Tag }}

- id: enpxio
  goos:
  - linux
  - windows
  - darwin
  goarch:
  - amd64
  - "386"
  goarm:
  - "6"
  targets:
  - linux_amd64
  - linux_386
  - windows_amd64
  - windows_386
  - darwin_amd64
  - darwin_386
  dir: .
  main: ./cmd/enpxio/enpxio.go
  ldflags:
  - -s -w -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.Version={{.Version}} -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.Commit={{.Commit}} -X dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/enpxio.git/internal/meta.BuiltDate={{.Date}}
  binary: enpxio
  env:
  - CGO_ENABLED=0
  lang: go
archives:
- id: default
  builds:
  - enpxio
  name_template: '{{ .ProjectName }}_{{ .Os }}_{{ .Arch }}'
  replacements:
    "386": i386
    amd64: x86_64
    darwin: Darwin
    linux: Linux
    windows: Windows
  format: tar.gz
  format_overrides:
  - goos: windows
    format: zip
  files:
  - licence*
  - LICENCE*
  - license*
  - LICENSE*
  - readme*
  - README*
  - changelog*
  - CHANGELOG*
snapshot:
  name_template: '{{ .Tag }}-SNAPSHOT-{{ .ShortCommit }}'
checksum:
  name_template: checksums.txt
  algorithm: sha256
changelog:
  filters:
    exclude:
    - '^docs:'
    - '^test:'
    - '^chore:'
    - '^style:'
    - '^refactor:'
  sort: asc
dist: ./artifacts/dist
env_files:
  github_token: ~/.config/goreleaser/github_token
  gitlab_token: ~/.config/goreleaser/gitlab_token
  gitea_token: ~/.config/goreleaser/gitea_token
before:
  hooks:
  - go mod download
  - go generate ./...
source:
  name_template: '{{ .ProjectName }}-{{ .Version }}'
  format: tar.gz
github_urls:
  download: https://github.com
gitlab_urls:
  download: https://gitlab.com
```
